segment.description: Mill Creek (GNIS 01303503) of Overton County, the stream through Standing Stone State Park near Allons/Hilham that flows NW into the Dale Hollow Lake/Obey River arm. Basin identity is the upper Cumberland (HUC 05130106 'Upper Cumberland-Cordell Hull Reservoir'), NOT the Caney Fork basin despite the catalog's 'tn-middle-caney-fork' region tag - a catalog geography flag noted below. NOT the Hickman County Mill Creek also stocked by TWRA.
segment.boundaries: Catalog: 'TWRA spring-stocked Overton County creek on the plateau's eastern rim' (no reach limits given). The three TWRA stocking sites, all named 'Mill Creek (Standing Stone State Park)' (TDEC-managed, spring, 250 rainbow each), cluster at 36.4709-36.4727, -85.4183 to -85.4208 in the park. The temperature record (TDECWPC-MILL013.2OV / TDECWR_WQX-TNW000004167 at 36.4764,-85.4236, and TDECWR_WQX-TNW000004169 at 36.4722,-85.4194) is at and immediately adjacent to the stocked park reach.

coldSource.notes: Free-flowing park stream, no dam on the stocked reach. Catalog wiring note: the roster gauge 03539778 flagged in an earlier wave was proven to be 'CLEAR CREEK AT LILLY BRIDGE NEAR LANCING, TN' (Obed-system Clear Creek, Morgan Co.) and is no longer referenced - catalog gaugeIds is now empty, which is correct since no USGS station exists on this creek (documented Overton County and statewide sweeps); leaving the region tag mismatch (Caney Fork label on an Obey/Cordell Hull-basin creek) as an owner-visible catalog item.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found; TWRA's program here is seasonal spring put-and-take rainbow managed with TDEC inside Standing Stone State Park (2026 schedule: weeks of 3/22 and 4/26 only; 250 rainbows per site per the stocking-locations layer).

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documentation found. The creek has no entry (special regulation or wild-trout listing) on TWRA's Tennessee Trout Regulations page as fetched 2026-09-18.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: TDEC monitoring at the Standing Stone State Park stocking reach recorded 28.0 C in July 2025, 26.7-27.9 C in other Julys/Augusts (2000-2025) and 25.6 C in June 2026 - summer temperatures far beyond trout tolerance under a two-week spring stocking program.
